sources.title: OCR interview note preserving the linked-list intersection wording

claims.text: The recoverable source asks for the first common node of two intersecting singly linked lists; it does not prescribe Java, node representation, cycle handling, or no-intersection return behavior.
Java, acyclic singly linked lists, object identity as common-node semantics, and null for no intersection are explicit answer-side choices.
The head-switch implementation matches an independent length-alignment oracle over deterministic and seeded randomized acyclic-list shapes and preserves identity semantics across edge cases.

validation.command: extract candidate Java; javac -Xlint:all -Werror; independent length-alignment oracle over deterministic and seeded randomized acyclic-list shapes
validation.reported_stdout: PASS intersecting=10140 disjoint=676 randomized=5000 oracle=length-align identity=pass same-head=pass empty=pass
checks: 10140 intersecting prefix/tail shapes match an independent length-alignment oracle
5000 seeded randomized shapes match the independent oracle
equal-valued distinct nodes are not treated as an intersection

boundary_tests.expected: common node is reference identity, not equal payload value
candidate does not claim the acyclic head-switch proof handles cyclic lists

findings: The repository OCR and tagged source preserve only the request for the first common node of two intersecting singly linked lists; Java, acyclic-input scope, node representation and no-intersection return behavior are not source constraints.
The candidate labels Java, acyclic singly linked lists, object identity and null-on-no-intersection as answer-side executable choices instead of attributing them to the interview source.
For the declared acyclic contract, the head-switch invariant is sound: each pointer traverses A then B or B then A, equalizing the two unique-prefix lengths before any shared suffix comparison.

An independent length-alignment oracle agrees with the extracted candidate implementation for 10,140 deterministic intersecting shapes, 676 disjoint shapes and 5,000 seeded randomized shapes; same-head, empty-input and equal-value-distinct-node boundaries also pass.
The answer correctly distinguishes node identity from value equality, states O(m+n) time and O(1) auxiliary space, and explicitly excludes cyclic-list semantics from the proof.
No fabricated project experience, placeholder implementation, unsupported source expansion or unresolved source variant was found.
